Scripts.OnClick:
local neighborhoodID = HouseReviewFrame.selectedNeighborhood local location = HouseReviewFrame.selectedPlot local editBox = HouseReviewFrameEditBox local text = editBox:GetText()
print(string.format("|cFFFFFF00HR Debug:|r SubmitReview - Saving for NeighborhoodID: %s, PlotID: %s", tostring(neighborhoodID), tostring(location)))
if not neighborhoodID then print("HouseReview Error: No neighborhood selected.") return end
if not location then print("HouseReview Error: No plot selected.") return end
if not text or not text:match("%S") then print("HouseReview Error: Please write some text before submitting.") return end
-- Ensure neighborhood table exists if HouseReviewDB[neighborhoodID] == nil then HouseReviewDB[neighborhoodID] = {} end
if HouseReviewDB[neighborhoodID][location] == nil then HouseReviewDB[neighborhoodID][location] = {} end
-- Store as a table with metadata local playerName = UnitName("player") local bnetAccountID if C_BattleNet and C_BattleNet.GetAccountInfo then _, _, bnetAccountID = C_BattleNet.GetAccountInfo() end local playerAccountID = bnetAccountID or UnitGUID("player") -- Fallback to GUID if bnet ID is unavailable
local entry = { text = text, author = playerName, authorGUID = playerAccountID, date = date("%d/%m/%y"), likedBy = { [playerAccountID] = true } -- Auto-like by the author's account } table.insert(HouseReviewDB[neighborhoodID][location], entry)
print("Review submitted for " .. location)
-- Refresh the display list if HouseReview_UpdateReviewList then HouseReview_UpdateReviewList() end
editBox:SetText("") editBox:ClearFocus()
-- Update UI State HouseReviewFrameSubmitButton:Hide() HouseReviewFrameDeleteButton:Show() editBox:SetText("|cFF888888You have already reviewed this plot.|r") editBox:SetEnabled(false)

local neighborhoodID = HouseReviewFrame.selectedNeighborhood local location = HouseReviewFrame.selectedPlot if not neighborhoodID or not location or not HouseReviewDB[neighborhoodID] or not HouseReviewDB[neighborhoodID][location] then return end
local bnetAccountID if C_BattleNet and C_BattleNet.GetAccountInfo then _, _, bnetAccountID = C_BattleNet.GetAccountInfo() end local playerAccountID = bnetAccountID or UnitGUID("player") local indexToRemove = nil
for i, entry in ipairs(HouseReviewDB[neighborhoodID][location]) do if type(entry) == "table" and entry.authorGUID == playerAccountID then indexToRemove = i break end end
if indexToRemove then table.remove(HouseReviewDB[neighborhoodID][location], indexToRemove) print("Review removed for " .. location)
-- Refresh the display list if HouseReview_UpdateReviewList then HouseReview_UpdateReviewList() end
-- Update UI State self:Hide() HouseReviewFrameSubmitButton:Show() HouseReviewFrameEditBox:SetText("") HouseReviewFrameEditBox:SetEnabled(true) end
